item: The diagnostics set is built beside the old one with a room check, the build hands its read connection back between members, a killed run's journal is carried, and a member's error text is scrubbed of the passphrase where it is made
key_paths: src/api/diagnostics/bundle.py src/api/diagnostics_volumes.py src/monitoring/exit_evidence.py src/monitoring/forensics.py src/monitoring/session_hwm.py tests/test_diagnostics_volumes.py tests/test_all_diag_read_release.py tests/test_member_error_scrub.py tests/test_exit_evidence.py
summary: The numbered set is built in a folder beside the live one and swapped in whole, after a room check that keeps the 512 MiB floor and drops the drive's one per cent, so a failed split leaves the previous set serving; a refusal says the earlier set was untouched only when one was there, and a quota error or a drive that fills halfway is a 507; files a killed publish left are swept for whichever sidecar loads. The build hands its pooled read connection back at every member boundary and the manifest's run.read_release counts released, nothing-to-release and declined, so the checkpoint record no longer names the build as the oldest reader for its whole run. A run that died leaves its journal and the next bundle carries it marked previous_run; each gated member records what the gate read; rss_peak_rise_kb is absent with a reason when the high-water mark did not move; the lifetime marks carry the time they were set and RSS and swapped-out pages are shown apart. The error texts the zip's members make from an exception (a member's error, the debug bundle's section errors, the gate's estimate_error, the chronology's error, the reasons, the journal-read failures) are scrubbed of the passphrase the process holds and the one in its environment in every form the code writes it in (as typed, and quote-doubled as PRAGMA key and ATTACH carry it, each of those as repr and as both JSON inner forms, and again where the text is itself repr'd or JSON-encoded, up to three levels, with the carriers' own variants as ASCII or not), the longest first, on the whole text before the cut to 300 characters, checked again, and withheld when the scrub cannot run or a form is left; performance.json's two error texts go through it, and the two warnings for a left-over journal log the scrubbed text and no traceback; every other record the app writes to its error log is the error log's to scrub (the runners change), not this change's. The room refusal says only what is true of what was on the drive: a set, files with a list another version wrote, files whose list could not be read, a folder that could not be listed, or nothing; strays such as .DS_Store are not counted
